eld.text: Linden Kenrith is chosen with Algenus Kenrith by the Questing Beast to quest for the high rulership, and Algenus becomes High King.
She gives up her sword's power to restore Rowan and Will, born to a witch who killed newborns for their blood, and adopts them as her own.
When Oko abducts the High King and turns him into a stag, the twins fail to protect the stag from the Wild Hunt, and Linden restores Algenus with his Questing Sword.
Learning the truth about their origins ignites the twins' spark, and they planeswalk away.
